extracted.intended_audience: Postdoctoral applicants to the Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund (prospective fellows for the 2027 award cycle)
extracted.subtask_description: Eligibility rules and constraints for applicants to the Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund postdoctoral fellowships for the 2027 application cycle, including degree date limits, sponsor requirements, and restrictions on concurrent awards or training locations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postdoctoral research experience limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Postdoctoral applicants should have no more than 12 months of postdoctoral research experience at the time of the application deadline of February 1, 2027 (i.e. applicant’s first postdoctoral position must not have commenced prior to February 1, 2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dual-degree M.D./Ph.D. applicants should contact the program office regarding extended timeline criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ph.D. conferral timeframe
rubrics_metrics.description: Ph.D. degree must not have been conferred more than 24 months prior to the application deadline of February 1, 2027 (i.e. applicant must not have received Ph.D. before February 1, 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dual-degree M.D./Ph.D. applicants should contact the program office (jccfund@yale.edu) regarding extended timeline criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: M.D. conferral timeframe
rubrics_metrics.description: M.D. degree must not have been conferred more than three years prior to the application deadline of February 1, 2027 (i.e. applicant must not have received M.D. before February 1, 2024).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ph.D. candidates without degree at deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Ph.D. candidates that do not have their degree at time of the application deadline (February 1, 2027) are eligible to apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If awarded, the applicant’s Ph.D. degree must be conferred prior to the start of the Fellowship and applicant must start their position in the lab prior to July 1, 2027.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consideration of extenuating circumstances
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants with extenuating circumstances are welcome to contact the JCC program office at jccfund@yale.edu.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contacting the program office may enable discussion of timeline exceptions or other accommodations; applicants are encouraged to reach out if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training at same institution/department discouraged; same lab ineligible
rubrics_metrics.description: Postdoctoral training in the same institution in which the applicant received their Ph.D. is not preferred, particularly if it is in the same department.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In the appropriate section of the application, please address this situation if you are proposing training either in the same institution or with the same department as your graduate work. Proposals that are in the same laboratory where the fellow received their Ph.D. will not be funded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Existing or accepted postdoctoral fellowship disqualifies applicant
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants who have accepted a postdoctoral research fellowship award are not eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Candidates may hold a T32 at the time of application, but not concurrently with the Jane Coffin Childs Award. Fellows may obtain additional awards or grants to cover research expenses only, but not stipends unless granted permission by JCC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required commitment from sponsoring laboratory and institution
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must have identified and have a commitment from a sponsoring laboratory and sponsoring institution prior to applying.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants whose position is dependent on their being awarded a fellowship are discouraged from applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship and award payment restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants may be citizens of any country, but awards for non-U.S. citizens can only be made to sponsoring institutions in the United States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit on number of fellows per sponsor’s laboratory
rubrics_metrics.description: No more than one Fellow per sponsor’s laboratory will be funded per award year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No more than two fellows may be concurrently funded in the same sponsor’s laboratory over multiple award years.
